//! `.rasqpkg`(zstd 圧縮 tar)の受け付け時の確かめ (S-035)。
//!
//! 開発者がコンソールから出した配布物を、**保存する前に**開けて、id / 版 / マニフェストを読み、中身が目次どおりかを見る
//! (`rasq inspect` / クライアントの `RasqPackage.open` と同じ決まりの、サーバー側の最小限)。動作の審査は rasq-judge と審査員がする。
//!
//! - 先頭が `bundle.json`(`schema: rasq.bundle/1`)。`root {id, version, kind, manifest}`。
//! - パスは相対で `..` を含まない。通常ファイルだけ。重複なし。展開後の合計とファイル数に上限(展開爆弾の対策)。
//! - `SHA512SUMS` の全行が中身と一致。

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::io::Read;

use serde_json::Value;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha512};

/// 展開後の合計の上限。
pub const MAX_UNPACKED: u64 = 256 * 1024 * 1024;
/// ファイル数の上限。
pub const MAX_ENTRIES: usize = 2000;

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Inspected {
    pub id: String,
    pub version: String,
    pub kind: String,
    pub manifest: Value,
    pub files: usize,
    pub unpacked_bytes: u64,
    /// 目次の `root.safety`(rasq.toml の `[listing.safety]`、権限ごとの理由など)。無ければ None。
    pub safety: Option<Value>,
    /// 中のファイル(パスの順)と大きさ。審査コンソールが見せる。
    pub entries: Vec<(String, u64)>,
}

fn hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    bytes.iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect()
}

pub fn inspect(pkg: &[u8]) -> Result<Inspected, String> {
    let decoder =
        zstd::stream::read::Decoder::new(pkg).map_err(|_| "not a .rasqpkg (zstd)".to_string())?;
    // 上限 + 1 まで読んで、超えたら断る。
    let mut archive = tar::Archive::new(decoder.take(MAX_UNPACKED + 1));
    let mut files: HashMap<String, Vec<u8>> = HashMap::new();
    let mut first: Option<String> = None;
    let mut total: u64 = 0;
    for entry in archive.entries().map_err(|e| format!("tar: {e}"))? {
        let mut entry = entry.map_err(|e| format!("tar: {e}"))?;
        let path = entry
            .path()
            .map_err(|e| format!("tar path: {e}"))?
            .to_string_lossy()
            .into_owned();
        if !entry.header().entry_type().is_file() {
            return Err(format!("not a regular file: {path}"));
        }
        if path.is_empty()
            || path.starts_with('/')
            || path.contains('\\')
            || path.split('/').any(|s| s == ".." || s.is_empty())
        {
            return Err(format!("bad path in package: {path}"));
        }
        if files.len() >= MAX_ENTRIES {
            return Err("too many files in package".into());
        }
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        entry
            .read_to_end(&mut bytes)
            .map_err(|e| format!("tar read: {e}"))?;
        total += bytes.len() as u64;
        if total > MAX_UNPACKED {
            return Err("package is too large when unpacked".into());
        }
        first.get_or_insert_with(|| path.clone());
        if files.insert(path.clone(), bytes).is_some() {
            return Err(format!("duplicate path in package: {path}"));
        }
    }
    if first.as_deref() != Some("bundle.json") {
        return Err("bundle.json must be the first entry".into());
    }
    let bundle: Value =
        serde_json::from_slice(&files["bundle.json"]).map_err(|e| format!("bundle.json: {e}"))?;
    if bundle["schema"].as_str() != Some("rasq.bundle/1") {
        return Err("bundle.json: schema is not rasq.bundle/1".into());
    }
    let root = &bundle["root"];
    let field = |k: &str| {
        root[k]
            .as_str()
            .map(str::to_string)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("bundle.json: root.{k} is missing"))
    };
    let (id, version, kind, manifest_path) = (
        field("id")?,
        field("version")?,
        field("kind")?,
        field("manifest")?,
    );
    let manifest: Value = serde_json::from_slice(
        files
            .get(&manifest_path)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("{manifest_path}: listed but missing"))?,
    )
    .map_err(|e| format!("{manifest_path}: {e}"))?;
    if !manifest.is_object() {
        return Err(format!("{manifest_path}: not a JSON object"));
    }
    for (k, want) in [("id", &id), ("version", &version)] {
        if let Some(got) = manifest[k].as_str()
            && got != want
        {
            return Err(format!(
                "manifest.{k} {got:?} does not match bundle.json {want:?}"
            ));
        }
    }
    // SHA512SUMS: `<hex>  <path>` の全行が、中身と一致すること。
    let sums = std::str::from_utf8(files.get("SHA512SUMS").ok_or("SHA512SUMS is missing")?)
        .map_err(|_| "SHA512SUMS is not utf-8".to_string())?;
    for line in sums.lines().filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()) {
        let (want, path) = line
            .split_once("  ")
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("SHA512SUMS: bad line: {line}"))?;
        let data = files
            .get(path.trim())
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("{path}: in SHA512SUMS but missing"))?;
        if hex(&Sha512::digest(data)) != want.trim().to_ascii_lowercase() {
            return Err(format!("{path}: SHA-512 does not match SHA512SUMS"));
        }
    }
    let mut entries: Vec<(String, u64)> = files
        .iter()
        .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.len() as u64))
        .collect();
    entries.sort();
    // 形が違うものは載せない(掲載に書くのは object の permissions / externalHosts / dataHandling だけ)。
    let safety = bundle["root"]["safety"].as_object().map(|o| {
        let mut out = serde_json::Map::new();
        for k in ["permissions", "externalHosts", "dataHandling"] {
            if let Some(v) = o.get(k) {
                out.insert(k.to_string(), v.clone());
            }
        }
        Value::Object(out)
    });
    Ok(Inspected {
        entries,
        id,
        version,
        kind,
        manifest,
        files: files.len(),
        unpacked_bytes: total,
        safety,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// テスト用の最小の配布物。
    pub(crate) fn make(id: &str, version: &str, tamper: bool) -> Vec<u8> {
        let manifest = serde_json::json!({"id": id, "version": version, "name": "テスト", "permissions": ["net.fetch"]}).to_string();
        let bundle = serde_json::json!({"schema": "rasq.bundle/1", "root": {"id": id, "version": version, "kind": "slot", "manifest": "manifest.json"}}).to_string();
        let sum_of = if tamper {
            "x".to_string()
        } else {
            manifest.clone()
        };
        let sums = format!(
            "{}  manifest.json\n",
            hex(&Sha512::digest(sum_of.as_bytes()))
        );
        let mut tarball = tar::Builder::new(Vec::new());
        for (name, data) in [
            ("bundle.json", bundle.as_bytes()),
            ("manifest.json", manifest.as_bytes()),
            ("SHA512SUMS", sums.as_bytes()),
        ] {
            let mut h = tar::Header::new_gnu();
            h.set_size(data.len() as u64);
            h.set_mode(0o644);
            h.set_cksum();
            tarball.append_data(&mut h, name, data).unwrap();
        }
        zstd::encode_all(&tarball.into_inner().unwrap()[..], 3).unwrap()
    }

    /// 目次の root.safety を持つ最小の配布物。
    fn make_with_safety(safety: serde_json::Value) -> Vec<u8> {
        let manifest = serde_json::json!({"id": "x.y", "version": "1.0.0", "name": "t", "permissions": ["storage.safe"]}).to_string();
        let bundle = serde_json::json!({"schema": "rasq.bundle/1", "root": {"id": "x.y", "version": "1.0.0", "kind": "action", "manifest": "manifest.json", "safety": safety}}).to_string();
        let sums = format!(
            "{}  manifest.json\n",
            hex(&Sha512::digest(manifest.as_bytes()))
        );
        let mut tarball = tar::Builder::new(Vec::new());
        for (name, data) in [
            ("bundle.json", bundle.as_bytes()),
            ("manifest.json", manifest.as_bytes()),
            ("SHA512SUMS", sums.as_bytes()),
        ] {
            let mut h = tar::Header::new_gnu();
            h.set_size(data.len() as u64);
            h.set_mode(0o644);
            h.set_cksum();
            tarball.append_data(&mut h, name, data).unwrap();
        }
        zstd::encode_all(&tarball.into_inner().unwrap()[..], 3).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn safety_in_the_table_of_contents_is_read_and_trimmed() {
        let pkg = make_with_safety(serde_json::json!({
            "permissions": [{"permission": "storage.safe", "reason": "保存する"}],
            "externalHosts": [],
            "dataHandling": "端末の中だけ",
            "somethingElse": "掲載には書かない",
        }));
        let s = inspect(&pkg).unwrap().safety.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(s["permissions"][0]["reason"], "保存する");
        assert_eq!(s["dataHandling"], "端末の中だけ");
        assert!(s.get("somethingElse").is_none());
        // 無い / object でないなら None(前の版の申告を消さない)。
        assert!(
            inspect(&make("x.y", "1.0.0", false))
                .unwrap()
                .safety
                .is_none()
        );
        assert!(
            inspect(&make_with_safety(serde_json::json!("not an object")))
                .unwrap()
                .safety
                .is_none()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn reads_a_package_and_checks_the_sums() {
        let ok = inspect(&make("dev.test.sample", "0.1.0", false)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            (
                ok.id.as_str(),
                ok.version.as_str(),
                ok.kind.as_str(),
                ok.files
            ),
            ("dev.test.sample", "0.1.0", "slot", 3)
        );
        assert_eq!(ok.manifest["permissions"][0], "net.fetch");
        assert!(
            inspect(&make("dev.test.sample", "0.1.0", true))
                .unwrap_err()
                .contains("SHA-512")
        );
        assert!(inspect(b"not zstd").is_err());
    }
}
